description: This file defines a utility class ContentTypeValidationDirective used to validate the content-type of HTTP requests in an Akka HTTP server environment. It includes logic to verify supported media types and extract media types from request headers, throwing exceptions when necessary.

classes.name: ContentTypeValidationDirective
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to validate the content-type of incoming HTTP requests and extract media types for further validation.

methods.name: ensureValidContentType
methods.description: Checks whether the request's media type is within the allowed set of media types; if not, throws an UnsupportedMediaTypeException.

methods.name: extractMediaType
methods.description: Extracts the media type from the request headers or defaults to the parsed content-type provided by akka-http.

methods.name: requestToLogString
methods.description: Creates a string representation of the request for logging purposes, including host, method, and path.
